family_unit: independent research programme/task structure; listed items are mechanisms, not independent statistical trials

cases.name: reachable-wrong-scope-verifier
cases.counterexample: verifier checks row count but claim concerns formula values
cases.expected: route true, semantic verification not established

cases.name: cached-new-label-old-artifact
cases.counterexample: result digest or protocol version belongs to prior candidate
cases.expected: reject current eligibility, keep historical result

cases.name: same-context-negative
cases.necessary_check: negative result has independent evidence and exact applicability
cases.counterexample: novel label requests repeat of same failed hypothesis

cases.name: changed-relevant-context-negative
cases.necessary_check: prior negative is retained with scope
cases.counterexample: data/metric/resource condition relevant to failure changed
cases.expected: permit justified recheck; never infer success

cases.name: historical-max-not-eligible-max
cases.necessary_check: archive still contains prior best score
cases.counterexample: winning evidence revoked for current protocol
cases.expected: eligible set shrinks; historical log unchanged

cases.name: inferred-environment-not-original
cases.counterexample: missing original file replaced by generated bytes
cases.expected: label synthetic completion; block faithful-replay claim

legal_controls: required facts present with matched source digest
new discriminating evidence explicitly changes relevant applicability
limits: no claim that LLM will select correct action
no proof of scientific semantic sufficiency from graph checks
no reproduction of the eight papers
independently generated hidden task gold still required
